qt: to the Commission Maciej Wąsik (ECR) Subject:

On 3 August 2026, I received an answer from the Commission to my two parliamentary questions (E-001756/20261 and E-001757/20262) concerning the contracts that DT Global had concluded with the Commission and implemented between 2018 and 2025. According to the information provided, between 2018 and 2025, a total of 266 contracts were signed with DT Global (legal entities: DT Global IDEV EUROPE SLU, DT INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT UK, DT GLOBAL EMERGING MARKETS UK) for a total amount of EUR 234 882 436. These figures are available in the financial transparency register, but do not specify which specific tasks were carried out under the 266 contracts concluded with DT Global. In its answer, the Commission stated that it carries out ‘systematic audits linked to the verification of regularity and legality of expenditure’. In light of the foregoing: 1.
How many and what kind of audits has the Commission carried out on DT Global Europe (all legal entities of DT Global) regarding the regularity and legality of expenditure between 2018 and 2025?
What conclusions were drawn and consequences brought to bear from the audits carried out on DT Global?
Does the Commission have any plans in the near future to carry out audits to verify the regularity and legality of expenditure under contracts implemented by DT Global?
